examples.description: The default auth type: an Azure AD App Registration authenticating with a client secret. Always available, regardless of Grafana feature toggles.

clientSecretObo.description: An App Registration that exchanges the signed-in user's token for one scoped to Azure Data Explorer. Requires the adxOnBehalfOf Grafana feature toggle. jsonData.oauthPassThru must be true; the plugin backend rejects the datasource otherwise.

currentUser.description: Authenticate as the Grafana user viewing the dashboard. Only available when Grafana has the azure.userIdentityEnabled feature toggle. jsonData.oauthPassThru must be set to true — the Azure SDK sets it automatically from the UI, but omitting it here causes authentication to fail because Grafana won't forward the signed-in user's ID token.

managedIdentity.description: Authenticate with an Azure Managed Identity assigned to the Grafana host. Only available when Grafana has the azure.managedIdentityEnabled feature toggle.

workloadIdentity.description: Authenticate with an Azure AD Workload Identity federated to the Kubernetes service account Grafana runs as. Only available when Grafana has the azure.workloadIdentityEnabled feature toggle.
